scope: Public ONVIF profile sources and their selected public XML dependency closure. No private ACF, member-only release-candidate documents, product credentials, or discovered device inputs.

network.redirectPolicy: refuse; canonical redirect targets are reviewed and locked before use
network.cachePolicy: Explicit fetch cache must be outside the repository; retrieval never writes into a publication tree.
network.onvifRepositoryPaths: Exact commit under onvif/specs; selected wsdl tree and LICENSE.md only.
network.hashFailure: error; never relock, overwrite, downgrade, or report an empty success

xml.parser: Python standard library syntax-only XML parser with explicit input bounds
xml.stylesheets: preserved but never executed or fetched
xml.importResolution: Exact recorded location and namespace to sourceId, then verified local bytes. HTTP namespace/import identities are not permission to fetch over HTTP.
xml.relativeImports: May traverse parent components only within the pinned upstream tree; no local filesystem traversal or encoded escape.
xml.namespaceIdentity: A namespace can span multiple files. Never select a source solely by namespace.
xml.validationBoundary: Hash, syntax, metadata, notices, and declared import closure are checked; this is not full XSD compilation, profile coverage, XML codec validation, or runtime conformance.

redistribution.default: no permission inferred from public availability
redistribution.exportRule: Only permission-cleared unchanged sources, their complete import/notice closure, and a source-subset provenance lock may be exported. A fetched source is never automatically vendored or cleared.
redistribution.onvif: Preserve the embedded copyright, unchanged-copy grant, and disclaimer. The repository Contributor License Agreement is not a blanket Apache grant over specifications.
redistribution.oasis: Preserve complete embedded OASIS copyright, unchanged-document terms, and disclaimers in every copied WSDL/XSD.
redistribution.w3cExplicitSoftwareNotices: Retain embedded notices and the full corresponding original software license. No upstream schema bytes are modified.
redistribution.w3cNoEmbeddedNotice: The public-site default W3C Document License governs unchanged XML/XOP documents. Retain its full notice and source-specific attribution in the accompanying source lock; no broader modification grant is assumed.
redistribution.profilePdfs: Seven original PDF hashes/URLs are locked; PDFs remain reference-only to avoid large bundled documents. Their page-2 notices were inspected and the exact bytes verified.

gates.basis: Embedded permissions limit copying/distribution to developing and evaluating the specification. A broader distribution right for this implementation/package has not been established.
gates.effect: Hash-pinned fetch-only inputs; explicit local development retrieval is separate from redistribution. --export refuses them, even if the bytes are already cached.
gates.resolutionNeeded: A reviewed applicable license/permission for the intended distribution. Do not replace April 2005 WS-Discovery with another protocol revision to bypass this gate.

gates.basis: Unchanged-document permission is not blanket clearance for transformed normative requirement datasets, generated derivative packages, patents, trademarks, profile symbols, or certification claims.
gates.effect: No package, site, repository visibility, or registry publication is performed. First-party licensing remains an owner decision.

excludedSources.reason: Private ACF inputs, Profile V/Security release candidates, and member-only TLS 2.0 are outside this public baseline.
Use the canonical Event WSDL and original OASIS WS-Notification closure, not tool-specific modified duplicates.
Not established as requirements of the selected profile baseline or its import closure. In particular, no ISO MPEG query schema is silently downloaded or relicensed through FederatedSearch.
